findings: Legacy date arithmetic made invalid leap-day deadlines and corrupted low/whitespace years.
Legacy JS Number update IDs rounded adjacent SQLite IDs, overwriting a neighbor or missing the intended row.
Bounded preservation must exclude exact inserted IDs, not all IDs above old maximum: SQLite may randomly allocate rowids after INT64_MAX.
repairs: Focused corrected retention calculator in TS/native; preserve existing nonnull deadlines and refuse overflow. Actual calendar-red.txt fails with2029-02-29 before correction.
Exact SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) and BigInt update bindings for document/bank IDs. exact-id-red.txt shows old wrong-neighbor2032 deadline and actual target stillNULL.
Typed digest excludes only known newly inserted row IDs; native full-width old audit row exercises random ROWID allocation.
independent_review.result: No remaining material bounded finding. Independent47-check harness,4 native normalization tests,2 calendar-filter tests and16 targeted TS tests PASS.

design_review.KISS: Eight fixed native-role pairs and two explicit retention targets; direct Gregorian deadline calculator and one private transaction, no policy callback engine.
design_review.DRY: Move existing strict date validator into pure engine/calendar for actual report/retention consumers. Reuse typed projection hashing/capture and immutable compiled schema catalogue.
design_review.separation_of_concerns: Core calculates dates without clock, DB or transport. Storage selects eligible rows, preserves original typed evidence, seeds/audits and verifies effects. CLI still owns no writer authority.
design_review.modularity: Data normalization is separate from per-step versioned SQL; optional normalization field explains phase digests while existing suffix behavior remains unchanged.

limitations: Only strict canonical normalized early schemas0–31 admitted by existing full-schema path; physical historical baseline VAT/GDPR/customer/company rebuilds, unknown variants and replay/adoption still pending.
Normalization transaction is deliberately stronger than legacy per-role commits and unwrapped retention loop; no claim that legacy full migrate became one transaction.
Successful semantic parity uses corrected TS functions, not known corrupt historical date/ID behavior. Existing nonnull deadlines remain unchanged.

New seed/audit timestamps are generated by SQLite defaults. Only these new timestamps are validated/masked for independent comparison; existing timestamps/IDs/types/multiplicities are exact. Public digests of the normalized phase can vary when new timestamps are generated on separate rehearsals.
No original writes, live legacy/Rust admission, full immutable domain behavior, hardware power-loss, cross-platform, server/GPUI distribution or full R12/platform completion.
Named anchors bind this declared scope, not full transitive application acceptance. Historical increment evidence refers to its own pinned commit.
